name: Living In Infinity
detailed_description:
About This Game

About 40 minutes

A short linear narrative adventure

 

Story Overview

From hunger, the world began to unravel.

The whole story started with a mushroom—strange, silent, and wrong. The moment Lin Meizhen ate it, her entire world began to twist into something unrecognizable—doors emerge where none should be; familiar things wear unfamiliar skins; shadows in the walls begin to breathe...

In a house where reality warps and shadows whisper, can she uncover the truth before the fog consumes her?

 

How to Play

Use specific items to shift between overlapping realities. Navigate a dual world to uncover puzzle clues, unlock new areas, and piece together the truth about yourself.

 

Key Features

u Shift between mirrored realities to uncover hidden truths.

u Solve puzzles, each a thread woven into the fabric of the story.

u Survive with only your instincts and the safety of a quiet hiding place.

u Immerse yourself in an emotional narrative, where warmth and hope flicker even in the darkest corners.

 

Character Profile

Lin Meizhen

Age: 17

A high school student with a deep love for literature and art.

Currently on leave of absence for unknown reasons.

 

Game Overview

Play as Lin Meizhen, a high school student who eats a suspicious mushroom at home—only to find her world twisting and distorting. A missing door? A strange room? Mushrooms appearing out of nowhere? When everyday objects reveal a hidden side, the truth may lie at the edge of hallucination.

Play as Lin Meizhen, a 17-year-old high school student who eats a suspicious mushroom at home—only to find her familiar surroundings beginning to twist and distort.
